protocol_type: Streaming layered single-pair Ethernet PHY. The MAC carries IEEE 802.3 Clause-4 frames (unchanged); the PCS scrambles + ternary-codes the stream onto PAM3 symbols; the PMA echo-cancels + equalises the single pair. There is no opcode/command protocol on the data path. For 10BASE-T1S multidrop, PLCA arbitrates transmit opportunities. Management is a separate MDC/MDIO (Clause 22 + Clause 45) protocol.

channels.name: MDI single twisted pair
channels.description: The single balanced twisted pair carrying simultaneous-bidirectional PAM3 symbols; echo cancellation separates the local and remote signals.

channels.name: xMII (MII / RMII / RGMII / SGMII)
channels.description: Reconciliation-Sublayer interface carrying the MAC byte stream into the PCS at the appropriate rate.

channels.name: PLCA Reconciliation Sublayer (10BASE-T1S)
channels.description: Grants each multidrop node a deterministic transmit opportunity (TO) in node-ID order; node 0 is the coordinator emitting the BEACON.

channels.name: MDC / MDIO management
channels.description: Serial management bus; Clause 22 basic registers + Clause 45 MMD extensions. Two-cycle address-then-data for Clause 45.

packet_classes.purpose: Carries user data between MACs; IEEE 802.3 Clause-4 frame format preserved.
subtypes: Untagged data frame (DA + SA + EtherType/Length + Payload + FCS, 64-1518 B)

packet_classes.purpose: Line-coding / ternary-symbol units below the MAC (NOT MAC frames).

subtypes: BEACON (coordinator node 0 starts a PLCA cycle)
COMMIT / transmit opportunity (TO) grant per node ID
YIELD (node with nothing to send passes the TO)
Clause 45 MMD address-then-data (PMA/PMD, PCS, AN, vendor)

mac_frame_format.pad: 0-46 octets of 0x00 to reach the 64-byte minimum.
mac_frame_format.note: The MAC frame is byte-for-byte identical to every other Ethernet speed — only the single-pair PAM3 PHY below the MAC differs.

valid_ready_handshake_rules: The single-pair data path is a continuous stream — there is no per-beat valid/ready handshake at the PMD; the PMA loop-times slave to master.
Link-up requires master/slave timing lock + echo-canceller/equaliser convergence (MSE below threshold) + PCS descrambler lock.
10BASE-T1S multidrop access is arbitrated by PLCA transmit opportunities (no CSMA/CD).
MDIO Clause 45: each transaction is an Address cycle (OP=00) followed by a Data cycle.

pcs_pipeline.step_1_scramble: Side-stream scrambler (master or slave seed) for DC balance + spectral shaping (automotive EMC).
pcs_pipeline.step_2_code_100T1: 100BASE-T1: 4B3B then 3B2T mapping of data bits to PAM3 ternary symbols.
pcs_pipeline.step_2_code_1000T1: 1000BASE-T1: 80B/81B block coding to PAM3 ternary symbols.
pcs_pipeline.step_3_pma: PMA modulates PAM3 symbols on the single pair (66.67 MBd for 100BASE-T1, 750 MBd for 1000BASE-T1).
pcs_pipeline.step_4_echo_cancel: Adaptive echo canceller subtracts the near-end transmit echo so the remote signal is recovered on the same pair.
pcs_pipeline.step_5_equalise: FFE/DFE adaptive equalisation; symbol-timing recovery (slave loop-times to master).

plca_protocol.coordinator: Node ID 0 emits the BEACON that starts each PLCA cycle.
plca_protocol.transmit_opportunity: Each node, in node-ID order, gets a transmit opportunity (TO); a node with a frame transmits, a node with nothing yields and the TO passes on.
plca_protocol.determinism: Eliminates CSMA/CD collisions on the shared single-pair segment by serialising access; bounded latency per node.
plca_protocol.transparency: Transparent to the MAC frame format (still Clause-4 frames).
